title: If I Had to Learn AI From Zero Today, I'd Use These 3 Free Websites
description:
No textbooks. No $500 courses. Just 3 free websites that actually make AI click.

🔢 Website 1 — Visual Math
All the core mathematics behind machine learning — but visualized so you actually understand it instead of just staring at dry formulas.

⚙️ Website 2 — Interactive ML Concepts
Gradient descent, activation functions, clustering, perceptrons — all in interactive code form. You learn by playing with it, not reading about it.

🧠 Website 3 — Inside GPT (the wild one)
Fully interactive breakdowns of GPT-2, NanoGPT, and GPT-3. You can see exactly how these models work under the hood — layer by layer.

These three websites alone will take you further than most paid AI courses.
